title: Efforts to Ensure Educators and Lecturers at Institutes of Higher Learning are Aware of COVID-19 Measures
what_it_is: Efforts to Ensure Educators and Lecturers at Institutes of Higher Learning are Aware of COVID-19 Measures

sections.label: Education COVID-19 ground practices
sections.summary: Schools use hygiene reminders, temperature-taking, stay-home rules and lesson packages on COVID-19 and total defence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Ground practices play a part in education, too.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: These include reminders on the importance of good hygiene, wearing a mask when sick, twice-daily temperature-taking, requiring those returning from mainland China, and now, Korea, to stay at home for the first 14 days, and cancelling, deferring or adjusting large-scale events to mitigate risks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: In the Institute of Technical Education (ITE), a Total Defence lesson package covering content on the COVID-19 situation will be used in all Life Skills classes this month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Polytechnics will roll out similar packages later in April, after their exams and term break.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: For example, the Singapore Management University's (SMU's) core curriculum for all Year 1 undergraduates includes a course on social resilience and total defence, using the severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) outbreak as one case study.

sections.label: IHL gatherings and cases
sections.summary: IHLs reduce student intermingling and shrink gatherings to about 50 students; three cases exist in IHLs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: On the first question, the guidance that IHLs are working on is to reduce the intermingling of students on campuses so that IHLs can keep on operating while mitigating the risks of infection and spreading.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: So, they are working with about 50 students for each gathering.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Tutorials, project teams, are all ongoing but the sizes have all been shrunk.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We have three cases now in our IHLs – one staff and two students.

sections.label: Limited campus exposure
sections.summary: Even 48 hours before symptoms, campus exposure is limited and localised due to mitigating measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Even 48 hours before the onset of symptoms, you find that their exposure in the campus is actually quite limited and localised because of all these mitigating measures.
